QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_62

question.text: Under SAS-1300, which is the STRONGEST indicator of REAL financial inclusion (not just awareness)?

answer.text: Number of people who attended awareness sessions (output)
Number of NEW FIRST-TIME bank accounts opened AND active 6 months later (usage-based outcome)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Account opening is activity; first-time + active 6 months is outcome. SAS-1300 emphasises USAGE over mere account-opening. The Jan Dhan experience showed that ~30% of accounts remain zero-balance; the SIA must measure active usage. **The Trap:** Option A counts awareness (upstream). Options C, B are irrelevant. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same logic in V-B (MF Foundation) and investor-account-activation in X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Require the SE to extract 'account status after 6 months' from partner bank. Active-account rate is the real SAS-1300 outcome — ask for active-account % broken down by gender and age.
